lines.learner: 머리가 아파요. 어제 잠을 못 잤어요.
lines.en: My head hurts. I couldn't sleep yesterday.
lines.roman: meoriga apayo. eoje jameul mot jasseoyo.

lines.en: Since last week. My throat hurts too.

lines.beaver_en: Does your throat hurt a lot?
lines.learner: 네, 밥을 잘 못 먹어요. 입도 아파요.
lines.en: Yes, I can't eat well. My mouth hurts too.
lines.roman: ne, bameul jal mon meogeoyo. ipdo apayo.

lines.beaver_en: Open your mouth. Do your teeth hurt too?
lines.learner: 네, 이가 아파서 물을 못 마셔요.
lines.en: Yes, my tooth hurts, so I can't drink water.
lines.roman: ne, iga apaseo mureul mon masyeoyo.

lines.learner: 코가 막혀서 숨을 잘 못 쉬어요.
lines.en: My nose is blocked, so I can't breathe well.
lines.roman: koga makyeoseo sumeul jal mot swieoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are your eyes or ears okay?
lines.en: My eyes are fine. My ears are fine too.
My belly is fine. But my arm hurts.

lines.beaver_en: Your arm? Does your hand hurt too?
lines.learner: 네, 손도 아파요. 다리도 아파서 잘 못 걸어요.
lines.en: Yes, my hand hurts too. My legs hurt, so I can't walk well.
lines.roman: ne, sondo apayo. darido apaseo jal mot georeoyo.

lines.en: No, I don't smoke for my health.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 약 먹고 오늘은 푹 쉬세요.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Take the medicine and rest well today.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. yak meokgo oneureun puk swiseyo.
lines.learner: 네, 몸이 아파서 일도 못 해요. 감사합니다.
lines.en: Okay, I'm sick so I can't work anyway. Thank you.
lines.roman: ne, momi apaseo ildo motaeyo. gamsahamnida.
